name: Major floods
summary: No GDACS orange or red flood alerts
state: GDACS listed no orange or red flood alerts on 7 Nov, with five green-level flood events. No single flood with mass displacement or major loss of life had been reported.

why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
